description: Add verified manufacturer CAGI performance data to the datasheets array. Do not enter estimated values as manufacturer data. JSON does not support comments; entryTemplate and fieldDescriptions provide in-file documentation and are ignored by the app.

entryTemplate.manufacturer: Required: manufacturer name used for search, for example Example Air
entryTemplate.model: Required: manufacturer model identifier, for example EA-100
entryTemplate.source: Manufacturer CAGI data sheet, document number, revision, and date
entryTemplate.notes: Optional notes about testing conditions or curve interpretation

fieldDescriptions.ratedPressurePsig: Optional number. CAGI rated discharge pressure in psig; searchable and applied to Rated discharge pressure.
fieldDescriptions.ratedCapacityScfm: Optional number. Full-load rated capacity in standard cubic feet per minute; applied to Full-load rated capacity.
fieldDescriptions.fullLoadPackagePowerKw: Optional number. Package input power at full load in kW; applied to Full-load package input power.
fieldDescriptions.zeroFlowPackagePowerKw: Optional number. Package input power at zero flow in kW. The importer adds this as a 0 scfm curve point when the performanceCurve does not already include one.
fieldDescriptions.ratedInletPressurePsia: Optional number. CAGI rated inlet pressure in psia; defaults to the app value when omitted.
fieldDescriptions.ratedInletTemperatureF: Optional number. CAGI rated inlet temperature in degrees F; defaults to the app value when omitted.
fieldDescriptions.curvePressurePsig: Optional number. Pressure basis of performanceCurve in psig. When omitted, ratedPressurePsig is used.
fieldDescriptions.curvePressureMode: Optional string: estimate or rated. estimate applies operating-pressure correction; rated uses the curve power without correction.
fieldDescriptions.controlType: Optional string: lu, mod, or vsd. Applied to the compressor control type when present.
fieldDescriptions.performanceCurve: Optional array of zero or more {flowCfm, powerKw} points. Both values must be non-negative numbers. Points are sorted by flow; use at least two strictly increasing points to activate the custom curve.
fieldDescriptions.performanceCurve[].flowCfm: Required number for each curve point. Airflow in scfm.
fieldDescriptions.performanceCurve[].powerKw: Required number for each curve point. Package input power in kW.
fieldDescriptions.source: Optional string. Copied to the compressor Data sheet / source field.
fieldDescriptions.notes: Optional string. Copied to the compressor Source Notes field.
